description: This file contains utility functions for handling Windows file paths, including detecting drive prefixes, skipping drive prefixes, handling UNC paths, and comparing file paths in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: int win32_has_dos_drive_prefix(const char * path)
methods.description: Detects if a path starts with a Windows drive prefix (e.g., 'C:') and returns the length of the prefix if present.

methods.name: int win32_skip_dos_drive_prefix(char ** path)
methods.description: Advances the given path pointer past a Windows drive prefix if present.

methods.name: int win32_offset_1st_component(const char * path)
methods.description: Returns the offset to the first component of a Windows path after drive or server prefix.

methods.name: int win32_fspathncmp(const char * a,const char * b,size_t count)
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two file paths up to a specified length.

methods.name: int win32_fspathcmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two file paths.

ctags.name: win32_fspathncmp
ctags.pattern: /^int win32_fspathncmp(const char *a, const char *b, size_t count)$/
